description: Use this when the user asks how a creator campaign is performing or for its report. One campaign's report: spend against budget, posts, approved views, cost per 1,000 views, each creator's posts, views, earnings and payout status, top posts and the authenticity spread. format "csv" returns it as CSV (rows "creators" or "posts", money in US dollars) plus a download link. Read-only, free.
name: creator_campaign_report
title: Creator campaign report (CSV too)
